literal: To the loving two, sweet indeed (is) wind in the middle to pierce not experiencing embrace.
translation: For two lovers, sweet indeed is an embrace so tight that not even the wind can pierce the space between them.
modern: ஒருவரையொருவர் விரும்பும் இருவருக்கும், தங்களுக்கு இடையில் காற்று நுழைந்து பிரிக்க முடியாதபடி தழுவிக்கொள்வது மிகவும் இனிமையானது.
explanation: This couplet describes the intensity and closeness of the lovers' embrace. The word 'வீழும்' means desiring or loving, referring to the deep affection between the two. 'வளியிடை போழப் படாஅ முயக்கு' paints a vivid picture of an embrace so tight that there is no gap for even the wind to pass through and separate them. The poet emphasizes that for such deeply connected lovers, this absolute physical closeness is profoundly sweet ('இனிதே').
